kuiper.purpose: Help humans and LLM-assisted workflows isolate patterns across code, text and mathematics, supporting faster iteration and discovery. Intended adaptations include GIS drawing, design studios and construction proposals.

capability_evidence.summary: The catalogue records a current Kuiper workspace and an earlier one-wafer release; this does not establish automated LLM integration.

gridatlas.purpose: Explore electricity-network sites, layers and connections.

ventus-grid-engine.purpose: Bring together drawing, topology and network experiments for energy-system development.

faraday-pulse.purpose: Investigate pulse propagation and memory through recorded experiments.

capability_evidence.summary: The linked destination is an experiment log; its recorded experiments are distinct from a production engineering capability.

dc-string-drawing.purpose: Explore a string-inverter DC topology drawing workspace.

ac-block-diagram.purpose: Inspect inverter, skid and ring blocks as a block diagram, without implying a complete electrical system or SLD.

deep-grid-engine.purpose: Explore the grid engine's module and dependency map.

pipeline-news.purpose: Find renewable-energy projects and follow the project pipeline.

solar-design-studio.purpose: Explore solar and storage modelling through maps, electrical layouts and project economics.

identity-registry.purpose: Find permanent asset identities, scannable labels and preserved history; the first release contains demonstration assets.

electricity-market-intelligence.purpose: Explore electricity and price dashboards using snapshots dated 18 June 2026, rather than live market data.

metals-cable-prices.purpose: Explore historical metal trends and dated cable-cost estimates.

lv-ac-dc-prices.purpose: Explore indicative LV AC and DC cable estimates dated 18 June 2026; these are not live supplier quotations.

33kv-cable-prices.purpose: Explore indicative UK DAP 33 kV cable estimates dated 18 June 2026.

cable-engineering.purpose: Learn about AC cables and find related cable guidance and tools.

dc-cable-guide.purpose: Learn about DC cables through the existing knowledge pages.

cable-selection.purpose: Explore cable-selection options using the existing tool.

electrical-scene-explorer.purpose: Inspect illustrative electrical geometry and modelled cable routes in a browser prototype.
